notes.text: Nucleotide exchange factor (NEF) for mitochondrial HSP70 (mt-HSP70/HSPA9), facilitating the release of ADP from HSPA9 to allow ATP rebinding, which is essential for the chaperone cycle (PubMed:28848044). Functions as a component of the presequence translocase-associated motor (PAM) complex, which drives ATP-dependent import of proteins into the mitochondrial matrix (PubMed:28848044). In the PAM complex, supports the HSPA9-driven pulling mechanism that translocates polypeptides through the TIM23 complex (PubMed:28848044). Functions as a redox-regulated component of the mitochondrial protein import and folding machinery, with its activity modulated by oxidative stress (PubMed:30098457). May control the nucleotide-dependent binding of HSPA9 to substrate proteins (By similarity)

Homodimer; dimerizazion is activated by oxidative stress (PubMed:30098457). Component of the PAM complex at least composed of mitochondrial HSP70, GRPEL1 or GRPEL2, TIMM44, TIMM16/PAM16 and TIMM14/DNAJC19 (By similarity)

NERCLIN functions as a negative regulator of cardiolipin homeostasis and mitochondrial ultrastructure, contributing to the stress-induced adaptation of mitochondrial dynamics. Responds to heat stress by ensuring OPA1 processing and cell survival (PubMed:37463214). Lacks nucleotide exchange factor (NEF) activity (PubMed:37463214). This isoform is specifically expressed in human and some non-human primates (PubMed:37463214)
Interacts with STML2; the interaction may regulate cardiolipin levels and mitochondrial morphology
